Title: Build updates for Azure Cognitive Search

Body.Content:
ML Ranking for Search Capabilities (preview announced at Build)​

Azure Cognitive Search offers a new ML ranking capability. ML ranking uses reinforcement learning and can continually tune the results to amplify relevance as users continue to interact with the search results.

Azure Machine Learning skill integration (preview announced at Build)​

Integrating a custom skill built in Azure Machine Learning just got easier with the addition of a new skill type, the Azure Machine Learning (AML) skill. Deploying a model as a secure endpoint from Azure Machine Learning and using the schema decorator instantly makes the endpoint discoverable in the Azure Cognitive Search pipeline as an AML skill. ​

Learn more.
